[RARC.4.6] **The dialect and contract bindings are sibling guards.** A DS
version proves the encoding is current. It does not prove that the behaviour
the artefact describes, or the sizing it was produced under, is the one in
force. Two bindings supply those guards: the dialect binding ([RBND.1.3]) and,
under `realtime`, the contract binding ([RBND.1.4]). Which artefacts carry
which binding, and what a mismatch refuses, are RBND's.
